title: Empirically evaluating commonsense intelligence in large language models with large-scale human judgments
reasoning: The paper includes religious and theological statements (e.g., 'God exists', 'No one religion is the right path') and moral/normative statements (e.g., 'Freedom is a fundamental human right', 'All human beings are created equal') in its dataset to evaluate and benchmark model agreement and consensus on common sense and human-like values.
